'''Jame''' is a [[Seanchan]] bouncer at [[The Yearly Brawl]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jame|Jame}} He is a [[Blademaster]].{{ref||Jame}}

==Appearance==
Jame has a round face.

==History==
Jame is married to [[Kathana]] and carries a heron marked blade at his side. He is loyal to the Empire and killed an assassin who admitted to hunting the [[Empress]], earning [[Matrim Cauthon]]'s friendship.{{ref/book|14|11}}

==Background==
Jame and Kathana are named for James and Jennifer Liang, two high-profile moderators at [http://dragonmount.com Dragonmount.com] and coordinators of [[JordanCon]].
